programs.title: Flushed
programs.desc: FLUSHED is a children's game show that tests not only mental but physical skills of the contestants. Two teams gather minutes by answering questions correctly and then it's a race to fit together a sequence of connective tubing within the timeframe racked up from the questions. If a team has more minutes, they've got a better chance of completing the build. And the stakes are high as the losing team faces getting slimed by the winners.
